Arab Woman Found Dead in Kozhikode Hotel

An Arab woman was discovered deceased in a hotel room in Kozhikode, Kerala. Police are currently awaiting the results of a post-mortem examination to determine the exact cause of death. Further actions will be decided based on the post-mortem report. The incident is under investigation.
